dedupe_keys.name: marktstammdatenregister mastr german register of electricity and gas market units and actors with daily full data export

description: The Marktstammdatenregister is the German register, kept by the Bundesnetzagentur, in which master data, mainly of the electricity and gas markets, must be recorded for installations and units, their operators and other market actors. Registration and updating are mandatory under the MaStR ordinance issued on the basis of sections 111e and 111f of the Energy Industry Act, mostly within one month. The public website offers searchable overviews of units and market actors, and a data download page provides the full extract of public data as a zipped XML file of about 3.1 GB, refreshed daily around 5:00 with the previous day state, plus exports for selected reference dates and a zipped export description. The download page showed a last update of 26 September 2026, names the licence as Datenlizenz Deutschland attribution 2.0 and notes a new export format since 1 October 2025. Coverage is Germany. Caveats: pages and the export description are in German, the website needs cookies, and the full export is aimed at experienced IT users. Simulation uses are a unit-level inventory of generation, storage and consumption for grid models, hosting capacity studies and capacity planning. Related records: data-smard-electricity-market-data-germany gives market data from the same agency.
